title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11
lineage: MAR > ? > R @ 3 @ ips.  >  AKAI GX 625 > Apogee Mini Me(24/96) >Apogee MiniDac(monitoring/mastering) > Wavelab 5.0(dithered to 16/44 via Apogee) > CD > EAC > WAV (TLH confirms no sbes) > FLAC (TLH)

ai_review.summary: A superb audience recording that captures the legendary Dark Star → Spanish Jam (and Lovelight) jam with crystal‑clear guest guitar work.
ai_review.review: The late‑set2 audience tape delivers a vivid picture of the February 11 1970 show, letting listeners hear Peter Green, Duane Allman and Jerry Garcia duel in an unforgettable Dark Star → Spanish Jam sequence. Reviewers praise the overall sound as “great” and “authentic,” noting only occasional level changes, while the performance itself is hailed as a high‑water mark for 1970.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing comments about both the musical performance (especially Dark Star/Spanish Jam) and the audience recording quality, with only minor mentions of sound fluctuations.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear house‑sound capture; guests are audible thanks to stage volume. Some reviewers note occasional changes in level but overall a listenable, authentic AUD source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong improvisational flow centered on an extended Dark Star that segues into a fiery Spanish Jam and lifts into a soaring Lovelight jam; guest guitarists add excitement throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for dueling with Peter Green and Duane Allman, with a clear, distinct tone.
